coaching.headline: TwinBlast and Riktor ran Kira and Mourn over, and TwinBlast tore down the duo lane's outer tower and inhibitor.

flags.text: TwinBlast went eleven kills to one death with the most hero damage and gold in the game.
Lt. Belica killed all five enemy heroes in the final mid fight of the game.
The team took all three Fangtooths, the Orb Prime and the Genesis Core, and nine structures to one.
Only won fight with no objective or tower inside ninety seconds: TwinBlast's double kill on Kira and Mourn.

focus.title: Play through the winning lane
focus.action: Play through the lane that is winning, and after every won fight take the nearest structure if an allied minion wave is arriving, or the nearest live neutral objective if not.

20.call: TwinBlast killed Crunch and Mourn with no allied deaths. TwinBlast is credited with the enemy duo lane outer tower less than a minute later, the first structure of the game.

15.1.call: Riktor killed Kira and TwinBlast killed Mourn with no allied deaths. The team took the first Fangtooth within the minute, and TwinBlast killed Crunch, the enemy jungler, at the same moment the Fangtooth fell.

26.6.call: TwinBlast killed Crunch and Akeron and is credited with the enemy duo lane inhibitor. On the offlane, Gideon killed Greystone, Lt. Belica killed Mourn and Kira killed Lt. Belica, and Kira is credited with the allied offlane outer tower.

30.2.call: Gideon killed TwinBlast in mid, and Lt. Belica killed Gideon, Mourn, Kira, Akeron and Crunch. The team took the enemy offlane inner tower and the Core within the next minute.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Owned the duo lane: took 7 of the kills on Kira and Mourn and is the recorded destroyer of that lane's outer tower and inhibitor. Fucking ruthless.
Hero damage per minute and farm both beat the recorded norm, and the only death came in the final mid fight, to Gideon. That is the bar next game.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Most objective damage in the game at 34931, and credited with the enemy mid inhibitor.
Hero damage was the weak number: 291 per minute against a norm of 530, lowest on the team. Next game, spend Hoarfrost and Cryoseism on the target TwinBlast is hitting.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Closed the game killing all five enemy heroes in the final mid fight. A shit-hot finish, and the mid matchup with Gideon ran 3 kills to 1.
Took offlane trips once the enemy mid outer fell; the Mourn kill there answered Greystone's death. Farm ran well above the recorded norm, and mid lost no structure all game.
83cc6af5-b98c-4d37-b83c-92fc4af56366: Did the support job: a hand in over four of every five team kills, the most assists and wards placed in the game, and one death, first blood to Kira.
Cleared 1 enemy ward while Mourn placed 19. When the duo wave is shoved, sweep the duo-side river for Mourn's wards, with a sentry if one is equipped.
5b6f002b-de66-4231-9d2d-9c1f11b481c4: The wall: most damage taken, mitigated and healed in the game, one death, and farm well above the recorded norm. Akeron, the lane opponent, finished without a kill.
Kill participation is thin: one takedown in the team's 22 kills. Once the enemy offlane outer tower is down, spend the farm lead joining the next fight on another lane.

matchup: Duo was TwinBlast and Riktor against Kira and Mourn; TwinBlast killed Kira three times and Mourn four times.
Kira's Shadow Glide resets on takedowns and stacks physical power; Kira finished with two kills.
Mourn's Contagion heals and armors allies; Tainted Rounds cuts the healing of each target TwinBlast basic-attacks.
build: Solaris, Tainted Rounds and Vanquisher is the winning core, and all three were finished.
Vaporize applies on-hit effects at double effectiveness, so Sky Splitter's current-health damage lands harder through Vaporize.
Ashbringer's basic attacks shave non-ultimate cooldowns, more on critical strikes, so Gunslinger's triple shot comes up more often.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when TwinBlast damages a hero below 30% health, with extra missiles from bonus attack speed.
Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after Rocket Dash.
Dryad's Boon is the first-minor alternative: basic attacks cut basic ability cooldowns, giving up the Forage farm bonus.
augment: Grenadier adds a third Vortex Grenade charge and Rocket Dash grants one, so more slows and more Gunslinger triggers.
Amplified Burst is the alternative: Vaporize gains range, giving up the extra grenade.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, far harder against targets below 20% max health.
A hero kill inside the Adrenalize window allows a recast, a fit for the top killer in the game.
improvement: Nothing to swap: the winning core finished, one death and the most hero damage in the game. Sound keep.
Sky Splitter, Imperator and Ashbringer sat outside the winning core, and nothing in this game argues against Sky Splitter, Imperator or Ashbringer.

matchup: Crunch was the jungle opponent and finished with one kill, the one on Aurora, and four deaths.
Turbo Crunch turns Right Crunch into a knockup, and Re-Crunch heals Crunch on every third hit.
The enemy ran three magical damage dealers, and Aurora carried no magical armor.
build: Spirit Of Amir, Magnify and Spectral Schematics is the winning core, and all three were finished.
Spectral Schematics and Dynamo trigger on immobilizing, which Hoarfrost's root, Cryoseism's stun and Glacial Thorns supply.
Magnify shreds magical armor on ability hits, which also helps Lt. Belica's and Riktor's magical damage.
eternal: Lotus grants a small random bonus every two minutes and on every takedown; six takedowns fed Lotus.
Flawless heals Aurora and nearby allies on ability hits against heroes, once per cast; Fragrance adds magical damage against nearby heroes.
Krix is the draft alternative: more maximum health for the jungler with the second-most damage taken in the game.
augment: Hypothermia is the alternative against Kira: Boreal Sweep shreds both armors and slows attack speed, giving up that root.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge burns up to three nearby heroes for several seconds and heals off that damage.
Overcharge pays only while enemy heroes stay inside the burn radius.
improvement: The build matches the winning core, so the build read offers no fix for the hero damage gap.
If Gideon or Akeron start focusing Aurora, compare a magical armor item for Dynamo, giving up physical armor and the immobilize amp.

matchup: Gideon was the mid opponent; Lt. Belica killed Gideon three times and died to Gideon once.
Gideon built Azure Core and Combustion, both max mana, so Void Drone's drain and Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage have a target.
Gideon scored three of the six enemy kills, the most on the enemy team, so track Gideon in fights.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings is the winning core, all finished, with Oblivion Crown raising magical power by a quarter.
Noxia's bonus needs a separate ability hit on a marked hero, which Void Bomb, Seismic Assault and Neural Disruptor supply.
Wraith Leggings adds ability damage against heroes below 40% health, suited to finishing low targets.
eternal: Vesh adds damage over time from ability damage on heroes; Mind Rot adds current-health damage on top.
Tithe of Death restores mana and stacks ability haste on takedowns; nine takedowns fed Tithe of Death.
augment: Devastating Bombs adds Void Bomb damage against isolated targets.
Combat Veteran is the alternative: movement speed and passive experience, giving up the isolated-target bomb damage.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for several seconds.
Epoch's stasis is the alternative against Black Hole and Purge, giving up the lifesteal and speed.
improvement: Nothing to swap: the winning core finished, nine kills and two deaths. Sound keep.

matchup: Duo was Riktor and TwinBlast against Mourn and Kira; Kira took first blood on Riktor, and Riktor killed Kira twice.
Mourn's Abduct pulls and Beguile mesmerizes, and Contagion heals and armors Mourn's allies.
Shock Therapy destroys shields and silences, and Skewer suppresses, lockdown TwinBlast can follow up on.
build: Stonewall and Warden's Faith stack physical armor against Kira and Crunch, and Warden's Faith cuts critical strike damage taken.
Transference pairs with Electrocute's shield: more movement speed and armor while shielded, and leftover shield returns as health.
The winning core is Dynamo, Xenia and Frosted Lure; Riktor built none of the three.
eternal: Nihil grows power and armor while Riktor keeps damaging heroes; From the Abyss regenerates health in hero combat.
Adaptive Plating adds armor matching the damage type taken.
The engine does not model Nihil; the field mostly runs Krix with Regenerative Tissue and Cannibalism on Riktor support.
augment: Zap O' 9-Chains makes the next basic attack after a cast zap nearby enemies, more damage in grouped fights.
Wanton Warden is the alternative: regenerate a share of damage taken, giving up the zap damage.
crest: Sanctification shields Riktor and nearby heroes, granting tenacity while the shield holds.
Visionary raises the ward cap, a fit for the most wards placed in the game.
improvement: Xenia for Stonewall shields an ally beside Riktor and adds magical armor, giving up health, physical armor and regeneration.
With one death and the most assists in the game, the current build is a sound keep.

matchup: Akeron was the lane opponent: zero kills, three deaths, and the second-most hero damage in the game.
Akeron heals off Crushing Maw and Consume bites, and Consume executes low-health targets.
Web Lash roots on hit, and the leap off a lashed wall knocks up and stuns.
build: Tainted Guard cuts the healing of anyone basic-attacking Greystone, such as Kira or Crunch.
Cybernetic Drive is the main flat magical armor in the build, beside Saphir's Mantle, against Akeron, Gideon and Mourn.
Overlord's cleave and Fire Blossom's burn add area damage while Greystone soaks damage.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health that grows with level; Regenerative Tissue regenerates after a stretch without hero damage.
Cannibalism paid once: one takedown all game, one stack of permanent health.
Feeding Frenzy is the second-minor alternative: attack speed per nearby enemy hero, with no takedowns needed.
augment: Tainted Oath blights enemies hit by Sacred Oath, cutting Akeron's healing and Mourn's Contagion healing.
Close Cut is the alternative: Make Way hits the nearest enemy harder, giving up the blight.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's Atlas grows size and health, damages nearby heroes and turns that damage into permanent max health.
Judgement is the alternative: an area hit that heals per hero struck, giving up the health growth.
improvement: The winning core is Overlord, Rapture and Aegis Of Agawar; Greystone finished Overlord and Aegis Of Agawar, not Rapture.
Rapture for Fire Blossom adds attack speed, omnivamp and close-range on-hit damage, giving up physical armor and the burn.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.8s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
enemyKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume

fedBy: Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 83% of the team's kills (more than 98% of Gideon mid players this patch) and died 3 times (fewer than about 67% of them). Tithe of Death turned 5 takedowns into ability haste, so Black Hole came back every ~82s instead of 105s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Gideon touched shortened Black Hole, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 82s late); fight right after Black Hole is spent.
Black Hole at rank 3: 105s base, about 82s by the end (22% shorter) from 28 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Soulbearer 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 10.
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 5 takedowns.
5 takedowns (3 kills, 2 assists) fed: Tithe of Death (minor).
Gideon dealt 22,505 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +480 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Greystone (level 18: about 107 magical armor, 49 after penetration; took 24,893 magical damage from heroes, 71% of all hero damage they took) and TwinBlast (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 12 after penetration; took 6,922 magical damage from heroes, 57% of all hero damage they took) that is about 38% and 33% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 19.4% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Event Horizon (augment): Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 2,493 healing recorded.

Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: Greystone took about 38% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 107, about 49 after 20 flat + 35% penetration).

(game text: Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.) (changes Cosmic Rift, 7s cooldown with their haste) Field: 48.3% in 2271 games, 32% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.6%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Void Breach, Cosmic Rift and Black Hole all add extra damage after they land. (game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) (game text: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.) Field: 48.8% in 2863 games, 59% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.6%.

Loadout minor Phylactery: After Black Hole, your cooldowns tick twice as fast for 4s and you get a shield based on your max mana, so Void Breach and Cosmic Rift come back sooner. (game text: After your Ultimate, gain 100% Cooldown Progression for 4s and a shield equal to 15% of Max Mana for 4s. 20s cooldown.) Field: 48.9% in 3295 games, 67% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.6%.

Loadout crest Soulbearer: A shield plus magic healing and movement speed. Pop it before a fight to survive the dive and heal off your Cosmic Rift and Black Hole damage. (game text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.) Field: 51.6% in 4921 games, 70% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.6%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Caustica, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 28 ability haste brought them back 22% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery) sits on the same trigger as the items (every ability hit set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Gideon killed built magical armor (Greystone). We killed Gideon 3 times.

Copy it? Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery): 48.5% in 2,573 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.6%; this 3-item core: 53.7% in 1,433 games, level with the 53.8% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

ability.name: Cosmic Rift
ability.what: Rip down a meteor from the sky, dealing 110/155/200/245/290 (+60%)(+5%) magical damage to all Enemies caught in the area of impact.

loadout.plain: Cosmic Rift deals extra damage based on the target's max health in the center. Aim the middle on tanks, or on enemies caught in Black Hole.

numbers: 7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 19.4% by the end (31 min)
loadout.plain: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Void Breach, Cosmic Rift and Black Hole all add extra damage after they land.

loadout.name: Tithe of Death
loadout.text: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
loadout.plain: Takedowns refund mana and permanently shorten your ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Snowballs Gideon's spell rotation as the fights go your way.

loadout.name: Phylactery
loadout.text: After your Ultimate, gain 100% Cooldown Progression for 4s and a shield equal to 15% of Max Mana for 4s. 20s cooldown.
loadout.plain: After Black Hole, your cooldowns tick twice as fast for 4s and you get a shield based on your max mana, so Void Breach and Cosmic Rift come back sooner.

loadout.name: Soulbearer
loadout.text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.
loadout.plain: A shield plus magic healing and movement speed. Pop it before a fight to survive the dive and heal off your Cosmic Rift and Black Hole damage.

loadout.name: Zap O' 9-Chains
loadout.text: On Ability Cast, Riktor’s next Basic Attack within 3s zaps 9 nearby Enemies, dealing 15 (+5 per Level)(+25% )(+30%) Damage.
loadout.plain: After every ability, your next basic attack within 3s zaps up to 9 nearby enemies. Weave a whip attack after Riplash, Shock Therapy or Electrocute to add damage across the whole fight.

loadout.name: Nihil
loadout.text: Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.
loadout.plain: Hitting a hero builds up power and armor the longer the fight lasts, and levels and takedowns make it permanently stronger. Fits Riktor staying in fights with Electrocute up.

loadout.name: From the Abyss
loadout.text: Restore 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health/s (Levels 1/6/11/16) while in Hero Combat or out of enemy vision.
loadout.plain: Heals you over time while fighting heroes or hidden from enemies. Sustain during the long brawls Riktor stays in.

loadout.name: Adaptive Plating
loadout.text: Taking damage grants matching Armor (1% per hit, stacks 10x).
loadout.plain: Taking hits stacks armor against that damage type. Good when Riktor is the one soaking the enemy's focus.

loadout.name: Sanctification
loadout.text: Safeguard:  Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.
loadout.plain: Shields you and nearby allies and makes them harder to lock down while it holds. Pop it as the enemy throws their crowd control in a teamfight.

fedBy: Nihil (Eternal): Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 31 minutes, fewer deaths than about 93% of Riktor support players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
18 takedowns (2 kills, 16 assists) fed: Nihil (Eternal).
Riktor dealt 16,541 hero damage, 16% of their team's, with +0 magical power from items.
Warden's Faith (item): Take 20% less damage from Critical Strikes.
Stonewall (item): Mitigate 5 (+5%)% of Physical Damage.
Adaptive Plating (Eternal minor): Taking damage grants matching Armor (1% per hit, stacks 10x).
Zap O' 9-Chains (augment): On Ability Cast, Riktor’s next Basic Attack within 3s zaps 9 nearby Enemies, dealing 15 (+5 per Level)(+25% )(+30%) Damage.

Sustain: 8% heal and shield power; Transference: Upon Shields expiring: 50% of its remaining value is restored as Health over 3s. Reduced to 25% for Ally Shields.; Sanctification: Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity.; 2,790 healing recorded.
Toughness: +895 health, +180 physical armor, +40 magical armor; took 25,636 damage, mitigated 34,003, died 1 times.

Loadout augment Zap O' 9-Chains: After every ability, your next basic attack within 3s zaps up to 9 nearby enemies. Weave a whip attack after Riplash, Shock Therapy or Electrocute to add damage across the whole fight. (game text: On Ability Cast, Riktor’s next Basic Attack within 3s zaps 9 nearby Enemies, dealing 15 (+5 per Level)(+25% )(+30%) Damage.) [15 + 5 a level: 100 at level 17] Field: 50.4% in 1864 games, 22% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout Eternal Nihil: Hitting a hero builds up power and armor the longer the fight lasts, and levels and takedowns make it permanently stronger. Fits Riktor staying in fights with Electrocute up. (game text: Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.) Field: 54.7% in 475 games, 6% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout minor From the Abyss: Heals you over time while fighting heroes or hidden from enemies. Sustain during the long brawls Riktor stays in. (game text: Restore 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health/s (Levels 1/6/11/16) while in Hero Combat or out of enemy vision.) Field: 56.4% in 401 games, 84% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout minor Adaptive Plating: Taking hits stacks armor against that damage type. Good when Riktor is the one soaking the enemy's focus. (game text: Taking damage grants matching Armor (1% per hit, stacks 10x).) Field: 55.8% in 416 games, 88% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout crest Sanctification: Shields you and nearby allies and makes them harder to lock down while it holds. Pop it as the enemy throws their crowd control in a teamfight. (game text: Safeguard:  Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.) Field: 51.1% in 3357 games, 40% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.3%.
Countered? 0 of the 1 players Riktor killed built magical armor. We killed Riktor 1 time.
Copy it? Nihil (From the Abyss + Adaptive Plating): 57.1% in 352 Riktor support games, above the hero's 50.3%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
